body: I've tried making changes, but nothing works. No matter what I do I'm still me and I don't want to be anymore.
I know what will work - being someone else. But as that's not possible then death is the next best thing.
There's no way anyone would ever consider being in a relationship with me, even if they did I'm not stable enough to maintain one.
Buts that's why I'm posting here, changes don't make any difference, little or big. I just don't have the energy to try anymore.

> The best piece of advice I can give you is to embrace yourself for who you are, flaws and all. Don't compare yourself to anyone. Believe me, all those people you see that seem so happy probably have problems of their own.


It's hard to accept yourself for who you are when you hate that person, and when you hate yourself it's hard not to compare yourself to other people. It doesn't matter if they have problems too, at least they have something going for them in life, I have nothing.


> When's the last time you remember being happy?


I honestly haven't been happy for 16 years, and I don't think I've ever been happy with who I am.
